description: Requirements outside the gap-analysis ledger (docs/requirements/implementation-gap-analysis.md), assessed by WI-0100. Classifications here are this audit's own; none is a completion claim. 'active: false' entries are excluded from the completeness denominator and the reason is stated.

Not in WI-0100's independent verification sample.

Depends on SIGNAL-VIS-001.1 and on Forma #159/#160, Ordo #92 and Visual Engineering #49.
Issue #104 remains open; no recorded acceptance against the issue's criteria.
No registered mutation testing (count-withheld-as-zero, off-by-one minimum, changed rounding, ...); the issue requires critical mutants to be killed.
Quality ratchet policy is neither present nor recorded as pending: Dokimos is not installed (see PLATFORM-CONTRACTS.md).
Praxis 3.11.0 and Ordo 1.7.0 are behind the current channel (3.25.0, 1.20.0).
No Registry release metadata for a Signal application artifact; no clean-environment reproduction from published artifacts.
